exact_path_candidates.title: Three frozen reconciliation claims held only by a substring match inside an unrelated figure
exact_path_candidates.why: `reconciliation_sweep.py --check` verifies a `{file, contains}` claim by substring containment on normalised text. Three frozen claims assert that docs/STATUS.md contains `281`, their records' follow-up count: `canonical-contract-locations#integrator-reconciliation-list#4` (verify item 1, in docs/reports/canonical-contract-locations/reconciliation.json) and `cycle18-timeout-teardown#integrator-reconciliation-list#5` and `cycle18-wait-failures#integrator-reconciliation-list#5` (verify item 0 each, in docs/reports/cycle18-priority1-integration/reconciliation.json). At base `8c1f15eb` the page carried 472 follow-ups and the three matched only inside `17,281`, an indirect-access leaf count of an unrelated row, so they were vacuous before DOCS-COMPACT-9; its compaction moved that figure to a checkpoint and they now fail. They are not rewritten (frozen records; the integration policy lets a close check its own record against its own tree). No gate or CI step runs them: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` runs no reconciliation check, the standing gate does not, and scripts/tests exercise the sweep only on temporary fixtures; they run only when a close checks its own record by hand (docs/agents/operations.md, Integration and reconciliation). DISCHARGE: the sweep's containment check is anchored to a token or a named field, so a figure cannot match inside another number, or these three claims are marked historical in a way the check honours.

exact_path_candidates.why: Cycle1B migrates __errno_location and strerror nested_call_admission to3/5opaque atoms with stable formal proposition IDs, exact Context bindings, conditional Lean decomposition/counterexample theorems and direct/summary dependency controls. No typed registry entry, semantic consumer, verified library body or automatic verdict invalidation exists. Any evidence recontextualization or checked verdict invalidation needs a separate scoped rule and matching proof; Unknown is not false and a refuted assumption is not a reachable C violation. Operator proposals AND/forbidden/OR/terminal remain separate semantics work.
